text:
Written in Hesiod: There is
no music or submusic beneath the firmament; what there is
is lambada
since Genesis, the stars washed clean
in the open expanse, a mortal man
and a mortal woman, beautiful,
dancing.

And in Guimarães Rosa: A single dancing wrist,
the palms held high instead,
with the scent
of paradise in the science of desire,
a kiss, a chaste
kiss on the nape, danced.

Let us praise the lambada, then, I think,
for being sacred.
